steps.en: Start a local project with the CLI
steps.zh: 用命令行启动本地工程

steps.en: Define a source model, metrics view and explore dashboard in YAML/SQL
steps.zh: 用 YAML／SQL 定义模型、指标视图和探索看板

steps.en: Runs data models and validates shared metric definitions
steps.zh: 执行数据模型，校验共同指标定义

steps.en: Select dimensions, measures and time filters in the dashboard
steps.zh: 在看板选择维度、指标与时间筛选

steps.en: Compiles metric requests to engine SQL and renders results
steps.zh: 把指标请求编译成引擎 SQL，展示结果

value.en: Exploratory dashboards share reviewed metric definitions rather than repeated formulas
value.zh: 探索看板共用已评审指标定义，不再重复公式
